event: A creak and thud sound comes up, which is the sound of the front door opening.

sounding_object.description: The front door. It is a light blue, arched wooden exterior door with a black handle and a four-pane window in its upper half. A floral wreath with green leaves, pink and white flowers, and some decorative Easter eggs is hanging on it.

reference_object.description: A white fireplace structure, recessed into the wall. It has a dark gray/black hearth, a dark wooden mantelpiece top, and a rounded firebox opening. Decorations on the mantel include two dolls and a garland of carrots and bunnies.

facing_object.object_name: Light-gray armchair further from the wall painting
facing_object.description: A light-gray upholstered armchair. This is the armchair located closer to the large arched window at the far end of the living room, and it is further from the white interior door and the wall painting next to that door. It has a blue cushion and a patterned throw blanket on it.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the white recessed fireplace and facing the light-gray armchair further from the wall painting, when the creak and thud sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
